shows.title: Old Masters in New York
shows.summary: Sotheby's is showcasing masterworks ranging from the third millennia B.C. to the nineteenth century, including the sale of the Diane A. Nixon Collection, one of the finest drawings collections assembled in recent decades.

shows.title: Master Paintings & Works of Art Part I
shows.summary: The sale features works of exceptional rarity and provenance, including Antonello da Messina's double-sided Ecce Homo and a Mummy Portrait of a Man from Roman Egypt.

shows.title: Master Works on Paper from Five Centuries
shows.summary: The sale features a Rembrandt's Young Lion Resting, a rarity in Rembrandt's oeuvre and the only animal depiction by the artist remaining in private hands.
